description: Orthoimagery from Spring 2024. The service provides a Natural Color view at approximately 12 inch resolution. The source orthoimagery is 4-band at resolutions of 12 or 6 inches. For more information on the project area see https://gis.ny.gov/2024-orthoimagery. Please contact NYS ITS Geospatial Services at nysgis@its.ny.gov if you have any questions.
